summary: Fix retained-removal diagnostic and fixture references to the existing fleet-file module.

replay.detail: No production replay, initialization, collector or writer activation.

schema.detail: No database, schema version, index, migration or persisted-format change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint and signed/current-key refusal producer rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Use the existing FleetFile and FleetRemoval types through their exported file module. No wire, schema, producer, refusal, aggregate or strict policy change.

downtime.detail: No additional daemon lifecycle transition. Source and selector validation do not establish runtime or filesystem latency.

manual.detail: The first hosted cost job stopped at FleetFile resolution before producing any measurements. The original and removal eight-control selections remain unchanged and need source-bound execution.

recovery.detail: No additional production mutation or rollback constraint. Actual control execution and broader signed-refusal/nonzero integration remain separately required.
